app.name: HideMyWindows
app.tagline: Hide your windows from screen capture

captureHints.hidden: Windows reports this target as excluded from capture. For a process, all visible windows are hidden.
captureHints.partial: Some visible windows of this process are hidden, but others are still visible to capture.
captureHints.unknown: The current capture status could not be verified.

dashboard.title: Hide a running app
dashboard.subtitle: Pick a process or a window, then hide it from screenshots and screen recordings.
dashboard.done: Done — {name} is now hidden from capture.

quickLaunch.title: Quick launch
quickLaunch.subtitle: Launch apps already hidden — handy for the apps you hide most often.
quickLaunch.empty: No quick launch entries yet. Add one to get started.
quickLaunch.name: Name (optional)
quickLaunch.addToStart: Also add a Start menu shortcut
quickLaunch.addToStartHint: Search for it from Start, or pin it to Start or the taskbar.
quickLaunch.startMenuHint: Find “{shortcut}” in Start. Right-click it to pin it to Start or the taskbar.

rules.title: Window rules
rules.subtitle: Enable a rule, keep HideMyWindows running, and open your apps normally. Matching supported windows stay visible to you and are excluded from recording.
rules.empty: No rules yet. Add a rule to auto-hide matching windows.
rules.persistentHint: Also re-check existing windows on a timer. New supported windows are checked automatically.
rules.resultCounts: {hidden} of {matched} matched windows hidden from capture
rules.issueNotice: Window rules: {count} issues. See Window rules for the result and details.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hideNotifications: Hide all notifications from screen capture
settings.hideNotificationsHint: You still see them. Screenshots, recordings, and streams do not. This applies to every app.
settings.closeToTray: Keep running in the tray when closed
settings.resetConfirm: This restores factory defaults and deletes settings left by older versions of HideMyWindows. Rules and quick launch entries are removed.
settings.restartHint: Some options apply immediately; others on the next launch.

about.title: About HideMyWindows
about.what: HideMyWindows lets you hide any window on your PC from screenshots, screen recordings and streaming software like OBS — perfect for privacy, streamers and anyone who shares their screen.
about.continuation: Rebuilt and improved by Mehdi. The original HideMyWindows by Cristian Gambino (@zCri) was no longer being updated, so this release rebuilds it on a lighter, more maintainable foundation while keeping the same name and spirit.
about.license: Licensed under MIT with the Commons Clause.
about.updateWhat: HideMyWindows will close, install the update and start again. Your other apps stay open and are not affected.
about.updateDev: Update checks run in installed builds.

launchProtection.title: Protection before apps appear
launchProtection.description: Protect matching windows before their first frame when apps are opened normally. This can conflict with games and anti-cheat software.
launchProtection.enable: Protect ordinary launches before the first frame
launchProtection.pauseHint: When off or paused, rule polling still works, but newly opened windows may briefly appear in recordings. Targeted hiding and Quick Launch remain available.
launchProtection.gameHint: Pause and wait for the paused status before launching your game. If it was already open, restart it: pausing cannot unload protection already loaded into other apps. Protection resumes automatically when the timer ends, even if the game is still running.

status.active: Protection before apps appear is active.
status.off: Protection before apps appear is off.
status.paused: Protection before apps appear is paused.
status.error: Protection before apps appear could not be fully applied.
status.unsupported: Protection before apps appear requires Windows.
